title: New-Arch migration: blank white screen, refs null, no error
symptom: After enabling the New Architecture, the app builds and launches but renders a blank white screen with zero diagnostics — no crash, no stack trace. Sometimes paired with refs always null, ref.current.measure() no longer working, or ActionSheetIOS broken.
expected_root_cause: Fabric's view flattening — Fabric removes unnecessary View wrappers from the native hierarchy when they don't affect layout, so refs pointing at those wrappers become null; plus React-18-concurrent race conditions exposed by Fabric
expected_fix: Put collapsable={false} on views you must keep in the native tree (or restructure to ref a view that survives flattening); add useEffect cleanup + AbortController; expect silent failures not stack traces
obvious_but_wrong: grep for a JS error / assume a bundling failure (there's nothing to grep — that's the trap)
source: Janani Umapathy, 'RN Migration: Every Issue I Faced'
